findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value for `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account message bundle is `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` — that is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence on the TOTP (mobile authenticator) setup screen of the account console. The English source is "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:"; the value should be a Lithuanian translation of that sentence (an existing Lithuanian wording for the same concept can be taken from the login theme), not the Italian one.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value for `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login message bundle is `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` — Italian text pasted into a Lithuanian file. Users with a Lithuanian locale will see an Italian instruction on the login flow's Mobile Authenticator setup page. The English source is "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:" and the value should be translated into Lithuanian.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value in the zh_CN account bundle is `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` which uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 應用程式) and Taiwan-style wording, while the rest of the zh_CN bundle is Simplified Chinese (e.g. `mobile=手机` on the previous line). zh_CN users will see a jarring mix of scripts. The Simplified equivalent already exists in the zh_CN login bundle: `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in i18next-based account-ui bundle
findings.body: The keycloak.v3 account console is a React app that renders this bundle with i18next, whose interpolation syntax is `{{0}}` (as used by all neighboring keys in this file, e.g. `error-invalid-length-too-short='{{0}}' must have minimal length of {{1}}.`). This change replaces `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}` with `{0}/{1}/{2}` and appends a Java MessageFormat choice pattern `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. When the account UI displays `error-invalid-multivalued-size`, i18next will not substitute `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and will print the raw choice expression literally, so end users see `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` instead of a formatted message. The Java MessageFormat variant belongs in the server-side bundles (base admin/login themes); this JS bundle should keep the i18next syntax (the previous `{{0}} ... value(s)` form, or i18next pluralization).

findings.title: Java MessageFormat choice pattern used in i18next-based admin-ui bundle
findings.body: The keycloak.v2 admin console renders this bundle with i18next, where positional interpolation is `{{0}}`. The changed `error-invalid-multivalued-size` message now uses `{0}/{1}/{2}` plus a Java MessageFormat choice pattern `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. i18next will not interpolate single-brace placeholders and knows nothing of Java choice syntax, so the user-attribute size validation error will be shown to administrators with literal placeholders and the raw choice string. The previous i18next form (`Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).`) worked; the Java MessageFormat version should only be used in the server-rendered theme bundles.
